bbcc596ff Bugfix: Correctly respects configuration switch `application.filesystem.unique.paths` when renaming files/folders
5c4ca95e6 Updates copyright message to 2017
1e8d8cde5 Improvement: The auto-renaming of newly created files/folders now happens onCreation instead of in multiple places. This solves multiple cases where creating files caused problems.
cf639bc72 Improves deployment export of files and folders, now only folders and toplevel files are included that either have "includeInFrontendExport" or "useAsJavascriptLibrary" set. Adds some more tests.
19e8ada51 Fixes uniqueness validation, adds tests for dynamic property validation, fixes recurring index rebuild in remote database mode, removes old validator code.
08f70aeab moved validation from Folder to AbstractFile as they also should not contain slashes or zero characters
52fa03f09 changed signature for onModification so that we get information about the modifications. this is used to determine if minification is triggered by a modification
c0f5be7d7 Modified path uniqueness contraint for AbstractFiles to be configurable via structr.conf using application.filesystem.unique.paths.
fad2b335e Updated license headers to 2016 and added where missing.
345f689a5 auto-append the current date/time to uploads if the filename would clash otherwise
14cfea383 created a uniqueness constraint on AbstractFile (see https://github.com/structr/structr/issues/158)
c335e5a3f - removed duplicate test for nonempty name in Folder.java - changed the validation of the nonEmpty name to the ValidateNode method instead of ValidationHelpers method - removed (now) unused imports
f3c33a13d Removed @autor line from JavaDoc in all Java classes.
bf0a1c068 Updated license headers to 2015 and Structr GmbH
ae69f13d3 Many changes in the filesystem area: added navigable folders, modified fulltext indexing to support large files, added deferred indexing, added word limit (default 50k).
51d704b37 Added SSH scp endpoint to allow easy upload of folders, added language-dependent stopword list for fulltext indexing, added agent implementation for background indexing, still work in progress.
2572fd72d Updated license headers
c4de7532c Merge branch 'develop' into remove_builtin_types
e25c6b56a First working prototype of overridden builtin classes to support linking with dynamic schema types.
ca39d353d Work in progress on replacing builtin types with dynamic types plus mixins.
ecf49fe7a Added query-based paging to websocket List command instead of late filtering. Added isParent boolean property to AbstractFile in order to identiy root folders etc.
9ebdc7196 Work-in-progress on improvements of backend image gallery
c8c58a353 Cleaned-up pom files. Updated license header.
4edb75bcb Updated license header
4bda56be7 Work in progress.
bb62361ce Work in progress.
d1e7be0c7 Work in progress on relationship entities.
55d6fe1fc Work in progress on new relationship entity handling etc.
b73c95119 Fixed bugs in FTP service Added FTP upload Added tests for FTP service
7f4da7a8b Initial version of FTP server implementation
5c7c8d610 refactoring for better separation of core and ui code

content.text:
This confirms it exactly: in commit `1e8d8cde5`, the `validatePathUniqueness` check was pulled out of `validatePath()` and moved into `onCreation()` (via the new `validateAndRenameFileOnce` wrapper), but `onModification()` was left calling `validatePath()` directly with no `validatePathUniqueness` guard — so renaming/moving files always enforced path uniqueness regardless of the config switch. The fix commit `bbcc596ff` simply re-adds the missing guard in `onModification()`, mirroring what `onCreation()` already had.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 1e8d8cde5bfab25b1d6e5ff39221c237374957f7

## Reasoning
(1) I looked at the history of `AbstractFile.java`, since that's the sole file touched by the fix. The fix adds an `if (validatePathUniqueness) { ... }` guard around `validatePath()` inside `onModification()`. I searched for where `validatePathUniqueness` was introduced and where the guard around `validatePath()` used to live, by diffing prior commits touching this file.

(2) Commit `c0f5be7d7` (Jan 2016) originally introduced the `validatePathUniqueness` flag and placed the guard *inside* `validatePath()` itself, so both `onCreation()` and `onModification()` correctly respected the switch since they both call `validatePath()`. Later, commit `1e8d8cde5` (Feb 20, 2017, "auto-renaming of newly created files/folders now happens onCreation...") refactored the code: it removed the `if (validatePathUniqueness)` check from inside `validatePath()` (making it unconditional) and instead added the guard only in `onCreation()`, wrapping a new `validateAndRenameFileOnce()` method. It did not add an equivalent guard to `onModification()`, which still calls the now-unconditional `validatePath()` directly. This left `onModification()` always enforcing uniqueness regardless of the `application.filesystem.unique.paths` setting — the exact bug described in the fix commit's title.

(3) The evidence is the `git show 1e8d8cde5` diff, which shows the guard being stripped from `validatePath()` while only `onCreation()` receives a new guard, and `onModification()` remains unchanged (calling the now-unguarded `validatePath()`). The bug-fixing commit `bbcc596ff` restores exactly the missing guard to `onModification()`, matching the pattern already present in `onCreation()` since `1e8d8cde5`. No intervening commits touched this logic (the only commit between them, `5c4ca95e6`, is a copyright-year-only change). I'm highly confident in this attribution.
